"""Serialize verified FEM, retained Radau construction, events and independent checks."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT=Path('/Users/b09501028/Downloads/bem2d.jl/Tatva-BEM')
OUT=ROOT/'bem/outputs';STUDY=OUT/'resumed-radau-fine-study-20261028'
FEM_STUDY=OUT/'fem-reference-prefix-replay-20261028'
FEM=OUT/'fem-event16-radau-study-graded-h2-end015625-4c-f64-replayed'
KERNEL=Path('/Volumes/Gauss-T7/Tatva-BEM-cache/fresh-radau2us-graded-q12-full45-20261028')
AUDIT=Path('/Volumes/Gauss-T7/Tatva-BEM-cache/resumed-radau2us-graded-original-causal-audit-20261028')
CASE=ROOT/'bem/src/finiteblock_bem/resources/cases/pmma_event16.toml'
SEED=ROOT/'bem/src/finiteblock_bem/resources/data/ev16_restart_float64.npz'
RECEIPT=OUT/'fem-reference-recovery-20261028-1230/bem_prefix_recovery.json'
PROOF=OUT/'radau-resume-checks-20261028-v4/fine-verify.json'
COMMIT='e184019896469d0ffc19f62c6f8fc503fc5f3280'
PYTHON='/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniconda/base/envs/tatva/bin/python'
FEM_OWNER=29337;FEM_ANCHOR='Wed Oct 28 20:56:56 2026'
ENV={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':str(ROOT/'bem/src'),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','FDBEM_CORES':'4',
 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1','OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS':'1',
 'TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS':'4','TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS':'1','JAX_ENABLE_X64':'true',
 'XLA_FLAGS':'--xla_cpu_multi_thread_eigen=false intra_op_parallelism_threads=4'}
frozen={};stages=[];child=None;controller=None;begun=time.perf_counter()
def now():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(p).open('rb')as s:
  for block in iter(lambda:s.read(4*1024**2),b''):h.update(block)
 return h.hexdigest()
def write(p,value):
 p=Path(p);tmp=p.with_suffix('.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');tmp.replace(p)
def status(phase,**extra):
 write(STUDY/'status.json',dict(phase=phase,pid=os.getpid(),utc=now(),elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-begun,
  stages=stages,goal_achieved=False,full_original_event_reproduced=False,same_accuracy_fem_advantage_verified=False,**extra))
def verify():
 changed=[p for p,v in frozen.items()if sha(p)!=v]
 if changed:raise RuntimeError(f'Frozen resumed-study source changed: {changed}')
def process(pid):
 r=subprocess.run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','lstart=,stat=,command='],capture_output=True,text=True)
 if r.returncode==1 and not r.stdout.strip():return ''
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Process observation failed; inspect before restarting')
 return r.stdout.strip()
def same_process(pid,anchor,fragment):
 value=process(pid)
 return bool(value and value.startswith(anchor)and fragment in value and not value.split()[5].startswith('Z'))
def stop(signum,frame):raise InterruptedError(f'Resumed study received signal {signum}')
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop);signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)
def execute(name,tool,*arguments):
 global child,controller
 verify();command=[PYTHON,'-B',str(ROOT/'bem/tools'/tool),*map(str,arguments)]
 started=time.perf_counter();utc_start=now()
 with(STUDY/f'{name}.log').open('x')as log,(STUDY/f'{name}-quota.log').open('x')as quota_log:
  child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  anchor=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(child.pid),'-o','lstart='],text=True).strip()
  cap=[PYTHON,'-B',str(ROOT/'bem/tools/limit_process_cpu.py'),'--pid',str(child.pid),'--expected-start',anchor,
       '--expected-command-fragment',str(ROOT/'bem/tools'/tool),'--cores','3.85','--output',str(STUDY/(name+'-cpu-quota'))]
  controller=subprocess.Popen(cap,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=quota_log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  status(name,child_pid=child.pid,child_start=anchor,controller_pid=controller.pid,command=command)
  with(STUDY/'process_samples.jsonl').open('a')as samples:
   while child.poll()is None:
    verify()
    if controller.poll()is not None and child.poll()is None:raise RuntimeError('CPU quota ended while numerical child is live')
    samples.write(json.dumps(dict(utc=now(),stage=name,child_pid=child.pid,process=process(child.pid)))+'\n');samples.flush();time.sleep(10)
  code=child.wait()
  if controller.poll()is None:controller.terminate();controller.wait(timeout=10)
 stages.append(dict(name=name,exit_code=code,seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,utc_start=utc_start,utc_end=now(),command=command))
 status(name+'_exited',exit_code=code)
 if code:raise RuntimeError(f'{name} failed; preserve all saved data and inspect its log')
 child=controller=None

os.chdir(ROOT);STUDY.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
try:
 if subprocess.run(['git','diff','--quiet','--','bem/tools','bem/src'],cwd=ROOT).returncode:
  raise RuntimeError('Uncommitted numerical code must not bypass exact-source CI')
 if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()!=COMMIT:
  raise RuntimeError('Start this exact-source queue from its recorded commit')
 proof=read(PROOF)
 if proof['status']!='verified_checkpoint_not_running'or proof['build_modified']or proof['committed_matrices']['work-family0.npy']!=256:
  raise RuntimeError('Actual fine source/prefix preflight failed')
 published=read(ROOT/'bem/docs/radau_sampling_checkpoint_results.json')
 if published['local_validation']['passed']!=7:raise RuntimeError('Complete resume controls are missing')
 for relative,value in published['source_sha256'].items():
  if sha(ROOT/relative)!=value:raise RuntimeError('Code differs from actual resume controls')
 initial=read(OUT/'radau-fine-initialization-20261028/summary.json')
 if not initial['initial_state_exactly_unchanged']or initial['original_equilibrium_mpa']>1e-7:
  raise RuntimeError('Original fine initial equilibrium/seed gate failed')
 old_frozen=read(OUT/'reference-first-fine-study-20261028/frozen_inputs.json')
 for path,value in old_frozen.items():
  if Path(path).resolve()!=ROOT/'bem/tools/prepare_raw_radau_resolvent.py'and sha(path)!=value:
   raise RuntimeError(f'An original numerical input changed: {path}')
 paths=[*map(Path,old_frozen),Path(__file__),ROOT/'bem/tools/radau_sampling_checkpoint.py',
        ROOT/'bem/tools/limit_process_cpu.py',ROOT/'bem/docs/radau_sampling_checkpoint_results.json',PROOF,RECEIPT,
        CASE,SEED,OUT/'radau-fine-initialization-20261028/summary.json',FEM_STUDY/'frozen_inputs.json']
 paths+=list((ROOT/'bem/src/finiteblock_bem').glob('*.py'))
 frozen={str(p.resolve()):sha(p)for p in paths};write(STUDY/'frozen_inputs.json',frozen)
 write(STUDY/'inherited_costs.json',dict(
  old_transition=read(OUT/'fresh-radau-fine-event-study-20261028-v2/transition_record.json'),
  old_constructor_pause=read(OUT/'reference-first-fine-study-20261028/constructor_pause.json'),
  interrupted_fem=read(OUT/'fem-reference-recovery-20261028-1230/interruption.json'),
  failed_direct_fem_resume=read(OUT/'fem-reference-recovery-20261028-1230/status.json'),
  resume_validation_controls=published['serial_test_controls'],
  all_previously_paid_work_retained=True,interrupted_previous_invocation_exact_timing_unknown=True,
  cost_rule='Use UTC interval unions for elapsed workflow costs; report productive constructor time separately. FEM wall time already contains serialized controls. No isolated same-accuracy speed claim.'))
 while True:
  verify()
  request=urllib.request.Request(f'https://api.github.com/repos/Gauss963/Tatva-BEM/actions/runs?head_sha={COMMIT}&per_page=5',headers={'User-Agent':'Tatva-BEM-validation'})
  try:
   with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=20)as response:runs=json.load(response)['workflow_runs']
  except OSError as error:
   status('waiting_for_exact_resume_ci',head_revision=COMMIT,network_error=str(error));time.sleep(30);continue
  selected=[r for r in runs if r['name']=='BEM verification'and r['head_sha']==COMMIT]
  if selected and selected[0]['status']=='completed':
   if selected[0]['conclusion']!='success':raise RuntimeError('Exact resume-source CI failed; FEM is left running')
   write(STUDY/'ci.json',{k:selected[0][k]for k in ['id','head_sha','status','conclusion','html_url']});break
  status('waiting_for_exact_resume_ci',head_revision=COMMIT);time.sleep(30)
 status('waiting_for_complete_replayed_fem',fem_owner_pid=FEM_OWNER,fem_output=str(FEM))
 while True:
  verify();dep=read(FEM_STUDY/'status.json')
  if dep['phase']=='complete_original_graded_fem_with_verified_replayed_prefix':break
  if dep['phase']=='attention_required':raise RuntimeError('FEM needs inspection; retained raw BEM data left untouched')
  if not same_process(FEM_OWNER,FEM_ANCHOR,'fem-reference-prefix-replay-20261028.py'):
   raise RuntimeError('FEM owner is no longer live without completion; inspect paired snapshots before resuming')
  time.sleep(30)
 fem=read(FEM/'summary.json');wrapper=read(FEM/'checkpoint_wrapper.json')
 if (fem['status']!='completed'or not fem['full_original_horizon']or fem['computational_dtype']!='float64'
     or not fem['source_and_protected_input_unchanged']or not fem['invocation_timing']['all_invocations_accounted']
     or wrapper['phase']!='completed_original_fem_horizon_with_verified_prefix'or not all(wrapper['state_bitwise_checks'].values())):
  raise RuntimeError('Complete unchanged FEM or graded replay identity proof failed')
 while any(same_process(pid,FEM_ANCHOR,fragment)for pid,fragment in [(29338,'run_checkpointed_fem_reference.py'),(29340,'limit_process_cpu.py')]):time.sleep(1)
 frozen[str((FEM/'summary.json').resolve())]=sha(FEM/'summary.json')
 source_command=read(OUT/'fresh-radau-fine-event-study-20261028-v2/status.json')['command']
 execute('resume_complete_radau_kernel','prepare_raw_radau_resolvent.py',*source_command[3:],
  '--durable-build','--resume','--resume-receipt',RECEIPT)
 kernel=read(KERNEL/'summary.json');journal=read(KERNEL/'sampling-journal.json')
 if kernel['status']!='completed_compact_radau_resolvent_kernel_only'or kernel['full_steps']!=22500 or journal['phase']!='completed':
  raise RuntimeError('Complete retained Radau kernel is missing')
 frozen[str((KERNEL/'summary.json').resolve())]=sha(KERNEL/'summary.json')
 runs=[]
 for first,last in [(64,128),(128,256)]:
  name=f'complete_event_segments{first}-{last}';run=STUDY/name
  execute(name,'simulate_compact_radau.py',KERNEL,'--output',run,'--restart-seed',SEED,
   '--static-initialization','fem-body-active-set','--segment-substeps',first,last,'--contact-root-recovery',
   '--kinetic-root-seed','--fft-cache-mb',8,'--fft-rows',4,'--max-memory-mb',12288)
  record=read(run/'summary.json')
  if record['status']!='completed_requested_horizon'or record['completed_steps']!=22500 or record['duration_s']!=.045 or not record['all_history_retained']:
   raise RuntimeError('Complete original RK event is missing')
  frozen[str((run/'summary.json').resolve())]=sha(run/'summary.json');runs.append(run)
 execute('complete_original_rk_causal_audit','audit_compact_radau_history.py',*runs,'--output',AUDIT,
  '--workers',4,'--fft-rows',2,'--max-workspace-mb',8192,'--max-memory-mb',12288,'--remove-reconstructed-families')
 causal=read(AUDIT/'summary.json')
 if causal['status']!='passed_original_causal_radau_equation_audit'or not causal['complete_prepared_horizon_checked']:
  raise RuntimeError('Complete original RK equations failed')
 import runpy
 import numpy as np
 compare=runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/'bem/tools/compare_float64_contact_history.py'));errors={}
 with np.load(runs[0]/'trajectory.npz',allow_pickle=False)as lower,np.load(runs[1]/'trajectory.npz',allow_pickle=False)as higher:
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(lower['time'],higher['time']);np.testing.assert_array_equal(lower['contact_y'],higher['contact_y'])
  for name in compare['FIELDS']:
   errors[name]=compare['COMPARE']['compare_saved_p1_fields']((higher['time'],higher['contact_y'],compare['bem_field'](higher,name)),(lower['time'],lower['contact_y'],compare['bem_field'](lower,name)))
 passed=all(all(v[k]is not None and v[k]<=.01 for k in ['relative_space_time_p1_l2','final_shared_time_relative_p1_l2'])for v in errors.values())
 write(STUDY/'constitutive_refinement.json',dict(field_errors=errors,relative_gate=.01,all_fields_passed=passed))
 gates=dict(constitutive_fields_one_percent=passed)
 for run in runs:
  destination=STUDY/('comparison-'+run.name)
  execute('compare_'+run.name,'compare_float64_contact_history.py',run,FEM,'--output',destination)
  result=read(destination/'summary.json')
  if set(result['field_errors'])!=set(compare['FIELDS']):raise RuntimeError('Incomplete whole-field comparison')
  gates[run.name+'_fields_five_percent']=all(all(v[k]is not None and v[k]<=.05 for k in ['relative_space_time_p1_l2','final_shared_time_relative_p1_l2'])for v in result['field_errors'].values())
  execute('bulk_port_work_'+run.name,'audit_radau_port_work.py',run,AUDIT,'--output',STUDY/('port-work-'+run.name),'--max-memory-mb',4096)
 write(STUDY/'field_gates.json',dict(gates=gates,all_passed=all(gates.values()),scope='Preconditions for initialized AD only; macro-time/space and full physical energy still require independent checks'))
 if not all(gates.values()):raise RuntimeError('Complete FEM/contact-field or substep gates failed; inspect before full fine AD')
 gradients=[]
 for run in runs:
  destination=STUDY/('initialized-ad-'+run.name)
  execute('initialized_ad_'+run.name,'check_compact_radau_ad.py',run,'--operator-audit',AUDIT,'--output',destination,
   '--jvp-batch-size',3,'--fft-cache-mb',8,'--fft-rows',2,'--max-memory-mb',12288)
  result=read(destination/'summary.json')
  if result['status']!='passed_complete_radau_adjoint_jvp_control'or not result['complete_prepared_horizon_checked']or not result['full_initialized_gradient']:
   raise RuntimeError('Complete initialized RK gradient proof failed')
  gradients.append(np.asarray(result['gradient']))
 relative=abs(gradients[0]-gradients[1])/np.maximum(np.maximum(abs(gradients[0]),abs(gradients[1])),1e-30)
 write(STUDY/'constitutive_gradient_refinement.json',dict(relative_difference=relative.tolist(),relative_gate=.01,all_parameters_passed=bool(np.all(relative<=.01)),macro_time_and_space_convergence_certified=False))
 if not np.all(relative<=.01):raise RuntimeError('Initialized gradient substep refinement failed')
 write(STUDY/'paid_cost_record.json',dict(stages=stages,inherited_costs=read(STUDY/'inherited_costs.json'),
  complete_fem_invocations=fem['invocation_timing'],exact_stage_wall_seconds=sum(row['seconds']for row in stages),
  previous_interrupted_invocation_exact_timing_unknown=True,no_nested_serial_control_intervals_added_twice=True,
  same_accuracy_fem_advantage_verified=False))
 status('completed_full_reference_fields_and_initialized_radau_ad',
  required_remaining='Review physical energy and event/front/wave metrics; independent macro-time/contact/bulk-space and gradient convergence; same-accuracy stability or isolated total-runtime proof')
except BaseException as error:
 if controller is not None and controller.poll()is None:
  controller.terminate()
  try:controller.wait(timeout=10)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
 if child is not None and child.poll()is None:
  child.terminate()
  try:child.wait(timeout=60)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
 status('attention_required',reason=repr(error),numerical_child_pid=None if child is None else child.pid)
 raise
